A '''red carpet''' is traditionally used to mark the route taken by [[heads of state]] on ceremonial and formal occasions, and has in recent decades been extended to use by [[Very Important Person|VIP]]s and [[celebrity|celebrities]] at formal events.

==History==
[[File:Barack Obama leaving Air Force One by night.jpg|thumbnail|[[President of the United States|United States President]] [[Barack Obama]] exiting [[Air Force One]] on red carpet]]
[[File:Halle Berry red carpet.jpg|thumb|upright|[[Halle Berry]] attending the premiere of the movie ''[[Robots (2005 film)|Robots]]'']]

The earliest known reference to walking a red carpet in literature is in the play ''[[The Oresteia|Agamemnon]]'' by [[Aeschylus]], written in 458 BC.  When the title character returns from Troy, he is greeted by his wife [[Clytemnestra]] who offers him a red path to walk upon:

{{poem quote|Now, dearest husband, come, step from your chariot.
But do not set to earth, my lord, the conquering foot
That trod down Troy. Servants, do as you have been bidden;
Make haste, carpet his way with crimson tapestries,
Spread silk before your master's feet; Justice herself
Shall lead him to a home he never hoped to see.<ref name="Aeschylus1973">{{cite book |translator-last1=Vellacott |translator-first1=Philip | author = Aeschylus | date = 26 July 1973 | title = The Oresteian Trilogy | publisher = Penguin UK | pages = | isbn = 978-0-14-190629-4 | oclc = 1004977950 | url = https://books.google.com/books?id=tuRiOESBVjkC}}</ref>}}

Agamemnon, knowing that only [[Greek mythology|gods]] walk on such luxury, responds with trepidation:

{{poem quote|I count it dangerous, being mortal, to set foot
On rich embroidered silks. I would be reverenced
As man, not god. The praise of fame rings clear without
These frills and fancy foot-rugs;<ref name="Aeschylus1973"/>}}

[[Oriental carpets in Renaissance painting|Renaissance paintings often show rugs and carpets in oriental patterns]], with red often the main background colour, laid on the steps to a throne, or on a dais where rulers or sacred figures are placed.

A red carpet was rolled out to welcome the arrival of United States president [[James Monroe]] in South Carolina in 1821.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.ego.net/us/sc/myr/history/gtown.htm|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/19980211004821/http://www.ego.net/us/sc/myr/history/gtown.htm|url-status=dead|archive-date=February 11, 1998|title=A brief history of Georgetown County (South Carolina)}}</ref> In 1902, the [[New York Central Railroad]] began using plush crimson carpets to direct people as they boarded their ''[[20th Century Limited]]'' passenger train.  This is believed to be the origin of the phrase "red-carpet treatment".<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.smithsonianmag.com/smithsonian-institution/what-is-the-origin-of-hollywoods-red-carpet-180949038/|title=What is the Origin of Hollywood's Red Carpet?|first=Amy|last=Henderson|website=smithsonianmag.com}}</ref>

By the late 1920s the red carpet had become synonymous with [[Cinema of the United States|Hollywood]] and film [[Premiere|premieres]]. A crimson-hued carpet was used for the first ever Hollywood premiere, the 1922 premiere of ''[[Douglas Fairbanks in Robin Hood|Robin Hood]]'', starring [[Douglas Fairbanks]], in front of the [[Grauman's Egyptian Theatre|Egyptian Theatre]]. For the following decades, the red carpet was one of the few places the public could catch a glimpse of stars like [[Clark Gable]], [[Jimmy Stewart]] and [[Grace Kelly]].<ref name="auto">{{cite web |url= http://www.bbc.com/culture/story/20160222-where-does-the-red-carpet-come-from|title= Where does the red carpet come from?|last= Baker|first= Lindsay|date= 22 February 2016|website= BBC News}}</ref>

In 1961, the red carpet was introduced at the [[Academy Awards]] at the [[Santa Monica Civic Auditorium]]. In 1964, the broadcasters of the ceremony opted to film outside the venue, showing the arrival of guests as they stepped out of their limousines. From this point forward, the red carpet became a globally acknowledged focal point for actors and actresses to make a grand entrance and showcase themselves at the Oscars.<ref name="auto"/>

==The entertainment industry and publicity events==
For at least 4 decades{{As of?|date=August 2026}}, a red carpet, often called the "Hollywood red carpet" has been regularly used in gala celebrity and entertainment events such as the [[Academy Awards]], [[Golden Globe Awards]], [[Grammy Awards]], [[Met Gala]], and [[British Academy of Film and Television Arts|BAFTA]]s. While the awards ceremonies take place inside the venues, much of the publicity occurs outside, with journalists discussing the [[red carpet fashion]]s and which famous [[fashion designers]] are being worn by the celebrities. Numerous photo-journalists are always present in the [[press line]]. The "Hollywood red carpet"  has become an important [[product placement]] arena for the fashion industry, and it is often coupled with [[Step and repeat|publicity backdrops]] which contain brand logos or emblems for photography and advertisement  purposes.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.chicagonow.com/the-photo-ninja-blog/2010/10/red-carpet-misconceptions/ |access-date=April 2, 2015 |title=Red Carpet Misconceptions |publisher=Chicago Now |author=Jeff Schear |date=October 11, 2010|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304054521/http://www.chicagonow.com/the-photo-ninja-blog/2010/10/red-carpet-misconceptions/|archivedate=2016-03-04}}</ref>

===Other colors===
[[File:Adam Jones on Opening Day 2018 (41104580191).jpg|thumb|right|[[Adam Jones (baseball)|Adam Jones]] of the [[Baltimore Orioles]] jogs down an orange carpet on [[Opening Day]] at [[Camden Yards]] in 2018. Orange is the team's primary color.]]
Carpeting in other colors may replace red in some instances to honor a certain cause, such as a "green carpet" to promote environmental awareness; or, for a sponsored event, the sponsor's logo colors, such as the [[Nickelodeon Kids' Choice Awards]], which uses an orange carpet to match the network's primary imaging color;<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.huffingtonpost.com/2015/03/28/kids-choice-awards-2015-photos_n_6957978.html |publisher=Huffington Post |access-date=April 2, 2015 |date=March 28, 2015 |title=Kids' Choice Awards 2015 orange carpet style was brighter than ever |author=Carly Ledbetter}}</ref> The [[MTV Video Music Awards]] have similarly varied, with some editions having used black ([[2022 MTV Video Music Awards|2022]]),<ref>{{Cite web |title=Lil Nas X Shuts Down the 2022 VMAs Black Carpet in a 'Heavy' Feathered Headpiece: 'I Feel Amazing' |url=https://people.com/style/vmas-2022-lil-nas-x-wears-harris-reed-feather-headpiece-skirt-outfit-photos/ |access-date=2023-07-26 |website=People |language=en}}</ref> white ([[2016 MTV Video Music Awards|2016]]),<ref>{{Cite web |title=Blue Ivy and Mom Beyonce Flutter Down the White Carpet at the VMAs |url=https://abcnews.go.com/Entertainment/blue-ivy-mom-beyonce-flutter-white-carpet-vmas/story?id=41718368 |access-date=2023-07-26 |website=ABC News |language=en}}</ref> and blue ([[2017 MTV Video Music Awards|2017]]) carpets.<ref>{{Cite magazine |last=Gray |first=Yasmine |date=2017-08-28 |title=12 of the Best Red-Hot Looks From The 2017 VMAs |url=https://www.billboard.com/photos/12-best-red-outfits-2017-vmas/ |access-date=2023-07-26 |magazine=Billboard |language=en-US}}</ref>

In 2019, the premiere of the film ''[[Detective Pikachu (film)|Detective Pikachu]]'' (2019) used a yellow carpet to match the color of its title character [[Pikachu]].<ref>{{cite web |date= 3 May 2019 |last= Silliman |first= Brian |title= Talking favorite Pokémon, sequel hopes on Detective Pikachu's yellow carpet |url= https://www.syfy.com/syfywire/detective-pikachu-yellow-carpet |website= SYFY WIRE }}</ref> The premiere of ''[[Sonic the Hedgehog (film)|Sonic the Hedgehog]]'' (2020) used a blue carpet to match its [[Sonic the Hedgehog (character)|namesake character]].<ref>{{cite web |date=17 February 2020 |last=D'Alessandro |first=Anthony |title='Sonic The Hedgehog' breaks video game pic opening record with $70m & reps 4th-best Presidents' Weekend debut – Monday Update |url=https://deadline.com/2020/02/sonic-the-hedgehog-birds-of-prey-will-ferrell-downhill-valentines-day-box-office-1202860119/ |website=Deadline |quote=premiere on the Paramount lot featuring games and activities for kids on a blue carpet.}}</ref>

At the [[95th Academy Awards]] in 2023, the organizers chose a different [[Champagne (color)|champagne]] color for the first time since the red carpet was introduced, as part of an attempt to better reflect a "day event into the night".<ref>{{Cite web |last=Gardner |first=Chris |date=2023-03-10 |title=Oscars 2023: Why the Red Carpet Isn't Actually Red |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lifestyle/lifestyle-news/why-oscars-2023-red-carpet-different-color-1235347177/ |access-date=2023-03-12 |website=The Hollywood Reporter |language=en-US}}</ref>

The ''[[List of Jeopardy! tournaments and events|Jeopardy! Honors]]'' event, which was held annually since Season 39 on the eve of the ''Tournament of Champions'', featured a blue carpet, in order to match the color of its background used during clues and dollar amounts shown on the clue board, from inside the Alex Trebek Stage at [[Sony Pictures Studios]].

==Phrases==
More generally, "red carpet treatment" and "rolling out the red carpet" usually refer to any special efforts made in the interests of [[hospitality]].{{cn|date=June 2023}}

==Airline lounges==
[[United Airlines]] operates a series of [[airport lounge]]s at major airports that were formerly known as "[[Red Carpet Club]]s".<ref name="United Club">{{cite web|title=United Club Changes|url=https://hub.united.com/en-us/news/company-operations/pages/united-club-is-the-new-name.aspx|archive-url=https://archive.today/20121217204009/https://hub.united.com/en-us/news/company-operations/pages/united-club-is-the-new-name.aspx|url-status=dead|archive-date=17 December 2012|work=United Airlines web site|publisher=United Airlines|access-date=5 October 2012}}</ref>
